# Withdrawn work

Work removed from the current cycle by an explicit decision. A withdrawn unit keeps its file and its
identifier, carries `state: rejected`, and names the trigger that would bring it back.

| ID | Work unit | Reason | Return trigger | Withdrawn |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<W1-AB-02a>` | `<what it would have delivered>` | `<why it left the cycle>` | `<the exact observable event>` | `<dd/mm>` |

Withdrawal is not deletion and not failure. The identifier is never reused, and a return creates no
new identifier for the same work.
